_about: Power-ups on the islands. A dying island enemy leaves one with `drop_chance` (at most `max_per_round` a round); an island boss always leaves one, and the last enemy of a special round leaves `special_round_end`. It lies there for `seconds_on_ground` (blinking for the last `blink_seconds`) and whoever walks within `reach` metres takes it FOR THE WHOLE PARTY. Kinds: `weight` = how often it is this one; `seconds` = how long it lasts (none = at once); double_points `mult`; nuke `points` = paid to everyone, `boss_share` = how much of a boss's full health it takes (everything else dies); carpenter = every shelter window boarded up again and `points` to everyone; perk (weight 0: only an island boss leaves it, `boss_perk_chance` of the time) = a random perk for everyone, over the limit too. Names and colours are the director's to change. Shapes are built in game/powerup_field.gd.
